Resolves #19173

`Neo.app.SharedCanvas` now forwards the pointer facts a camera needs: `onMouseDown`, `onMouseUp` and `onWheel` join click, move and leave, all through one `forwardPointer` report (canvas-relative position when the event has one, `button`, `buttons`, the four modifiers, wheel deltas with `deltaMode`). `Neo.canvas.Base` keeps `dx/dy`, `buttons` and the modifiers on `mouse` (idle on leave and `clearGraph`, one static `idleMouseState()` on the class) and dispatches `down`, `up` and `wheel` to no-op hooks beside `onMouseClick`. On the main thread, `DomEvents#onWheel` falls back to the node a component listens on locally, so a canvas outside the global wheel target list receives deltas, and the wheel payload now carries the pointer position and the modifiers. Gestures stay in subclasses; Header and the Portal canvases are not in the diff.

Evidence: L3 (the D#19151 observatory renderer, run in the engine's canvas worker on this head: a drag orbits, a wheel zooms) → L2 required for AC-1..3, L3 for AC-4. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI: `test/playwright/unit/canvas/PointerInput.spec.mjs` — "down, up and move carry canvas-relative coordinates, buttons and modifiers", "wheel carries the deltas beside the position", "click and leave keep their shape", "a report without a pointer position carries none", "nothing is forwarded before the canvas is ready or measured" |
| AC-2 | CI: same spec — "starts idle, and a leave returns to idle from any state", "the first report after a leave moves by nothing", "clearGraph resets the pointer with the rest of the state" |
| AC-3 | CI: same spec — "down, up, wheel and click reach their hooks with the payload"; `test/playwright/unit/main/DomEvents.spec.mjs` — "a wheel event reaches the app for a node a component listens on locally, and not for the body". Red-first at `origin/dev` (`2d993a26cb`): PointerInput 7 failed / 1 passed (the click-and-leave control); the DomEvents wheel arm failed with the focusout arm as the control. Green at this head; the canvas-owning tree plus DomEvents 70/70 |
| AC-4 | Outside CI, delivered: the observatory witness (D#19151 H3-a, an untracked app run on this head merged with #19169's branch) wires `mousedown` / `mousemove` / `mouseup` / `mouseleave` on its `SharedCanvas` item and `wheel: {local: true, passive: false}`. In the canvas worker (Chromium, ANGLE Metal / Apple M5 Max): a drag orbited the camera (yaw 3.35 → 3.72, pitch 0.25 → 0.43), a wheel zoomed it (dist 3.20 → 5.28 out; 2.15 in, with `ctrl=false` carried), and after the position fix a wheel followed by a drag reads yaw 1.63 / pitch 0.07 — no NaN; zero console errors from the app |

## Deltas from ticket
- The main thread's wheel payload also gains `clientX`, `clientY`, `deltaMode` and the four modifiers: the ticket assumed they were there, but `getEventData` carries none of them — the witness read `ctrl=undefined` and then `yaw NaN` before this.
- `forwardPointer` reports `x/y` only when the event has a position, so a positionless report leaves the worker's position alone.
- `idleMouseState()` is a static method, not a module-scope helper (`check-class-module-scope`: subclasses and `Neo.overwrites` can reach it).

## Test Evidence
- Red-first and the canvas-worker receipts as in the AC rows; the witness app lives outside the repository (D#19151 archives it), so its run is a receipt, not a spec.
- All other coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] The AC-4 receipt is posted on D#19151 once the PR merges (its H3 rows name this bridge).

- f8c09adcf4 — the wheel payload carries its modifiers and `deltaMode`
- 913365ddf7 — the wheel payload carries the pointer position; a report without one leaves the position alone
